samples.excerpt:

Nyathi lụrụ Caroline ma ha nwere ụmụ atọ.

samples.excerpt:
Sir Aly Tewfik Shoulda, Pasha (Templeeti:Lang-ar; 17 Ọgọst 1891 – 31 Mee 1964) bụ dọkịta si mba Ijipt na onye guzobere World Health Organisation .


=== Mmalite Ndụ na agụmakwụkwọ Ya ===
A mụrụ Aly Tewfik Shousha na Cairo, Egypt na 17 August 1891. Ọ gụsịrị akwụkwọ na Ụlọ akwụkwọ ọmụmụ ahụike, Mahadum Humboldt, Berlin n'afọ 1915, na ọkachamara na ọmụmụ bacteriology na Mahadum Zurich. O mechara bụrụ onye inyeaka na Hygienische Institute dị na Zurich (1916–1917).
